verdict.rationale: The cubic CLI reviews local changes before you push and generates a fix prompt for your coding agent. cubic can also be installed and connected in Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI, with skills for code review, so issues surface while code is still local. Missing for 10: no evidence that the local/IDE review uses the same rules, custom agents and memory as the PR review; no evidence of a native in-editor inline findings experience beyond the CLI and agent route; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
